KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_RULE_FTUE_BODY_1:
The Knowledge Demon has a separate card pile unlike other characters, called the [gold]Library[/gold].
The [gold]Library[/gold] appears above your [gold]hand[/gold].
Through [gold]Record[/gold], you can add [gold]temporary copies[/gold] of certain cards to the [gold]Library[/gold].
KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_RULE_FTUE_BODY_2:
When a card you [red]manually play[/red] enters the [red]discard pile[/red], it is [gold]Recorded[/gold].
Some card effects can also trigger [gold]Record[/gold].
KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_RULE_FTUE_BODY_3:
When the [gold]Library[/gold] contains more than [blue]9[/blue] cards, [gold]Knowledge Overload[/gold] triggers.
[gold]Knowledge Overload[/gold] lets you repeatedly choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] cards from the [gold]Library[/gold] to play automatically, then [gold]discard[/gold] the other [blue]2[/blue].
This [gold]discard[/gold] can trigger cards' [gold]Sly[/gold] effects.
[blue]Note: Cards in the Library are removed from combat when played or discarded. They do not enter the discard pile.[/blue]
UNIQUE_RULE_FTUE_BODY_1:
[gold]Unique[/gold] is a keyword.
Only [blue]1[/blue] card with the same name and the [gold]Unique[/gold] keyword can exist in combat.
Cards in combat include your [gold]hand[/gold], [gold]Library[/gold], [gold]draw pile[/gold], [gold]discard pile[/gold], and [gold]exhaust pile[/gold].
UNIQUE_RULE_FTUE_BODY_2:
If [blue]2[/blue] cards with the same name and the [gold]Unique[/gold] keyword appear in combat, the second card is [gold]transformed[/gold].
Because [gold]Unique[/gold] interacts with the copying behavior of [gold]Record[/gold], [gold]Recording[/gold] a [gold]Unique[/gold] card immediately triggers [gold]Transform[/gold].
UNIQUE_RULE_FTUE_BODY_3:
Similarly, only [blue]1[/blue] card with the same name and the [gold]Unique[/gold] keyword can exist in your deck.
If you add another [gold]Unique[/gold] card with the same name, it is immediately [gold]transformed[/gold].
INFINITY_RULE_FTUE_BODY_1:
Congratulations, you triggered [gold]Infinite[/gold]!
When a specific effect creates an infinite [gold]transformation[/gold] loop, it transforms into [gold]Infinite[/gold].
Explore and discover more ways to trigger [gold]Infinite[/gold]!
